observations.inspection: Viewed all eight final raw renders together. Coherent long nose and swept cabin; front LED blades differ clearly from rear round lamps; body and four wheels remain coherent through yaw.

Viewed true native pixels across all eight directions. Near-side wheels read as dark circles with alloy centers; far wheels are naturally occluded in side views and appear at the end-view silhouette. No detached tires or clipped canvas observed.

Viewed labelled raw, reduced, native and 4x nearest stages plus unchanged compact references. Glass borders and roof/glass separation remain readable. Gloss highlights become broad pale-red clusters and some stair-step noise. Tiny grille, tire and rim details disappear or merge at native size.

Inspected larger individual side, front-oblique, front and rear-oblique beauty renders. Curved panels, wheel arches, tires/rims, side/hood intakes, LED blades and circular rear lenses are genuinely geometric. No bitmap feature patch was substituted.
All eight encoded frames and 350ms durations decoded and compared exactly to checker-composited 4x nearest native sprites. No real-time player inspection claimed.
Inspected first pass before changing lights: broad gray clearcoat patches were distracting. Final lighting reduces that defect without pixel redraw. Initial raw and packed outputs retained.
